description: Remove one or more nodes, with their descendants, from a scene. Always-array: pass a single-element nodePaths array for a one-off delete. Saves once at the end. The scene root, a node inside an instanced scene, and a node inherited from a base scene cannot be deleted: that entry reports an error and the rest still process. Returns: results[], one entry per nodePath in input order, each with success or error. Errors while a runtime session is live on this project.

nodePaths.description: Node paths from scene root to delete (e.g. ["root/Player/Sprite2D"])

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

name: delete_nodes

resolvedNodePath.description: Where nodePath led, in root/... form. Present when the node was found; differs from nodePath for a %Name path.
